responsibility: This file implements libgccjit’s fake GCC language front end that lets JIT-constructed code run through the normal middle end without a source-language parser. It defines the JIT language hooks, common and format attribute tables, a minimal language-specific tree/identifier setup, GC root registration tied to the active playback context, type-for-mode mapping, and diagnostic callbacks that forward GCC diagnostics back into playback/recording contexts. Its key role is to initialize enough frontend state for GCC to accept trees produced by jit-playback and to trigger replay of the recorded API actions as the module’s effective “parse_file” stage.
